csv_project_name: Engineering Service for Fern Drive Bridge Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: The County of Santa Cruz, Department of Community Development & Infrastructure is seeking an engineering design firm to provide design services for the Fern Drive Bridge Replacement Project (Bridge No. 36C-0071) over the San Lorenzo River in Santa Cruz County. Descriptions of the bridge conditions and anticipated work are described herein the RFP and attached appendices. The County is seeking a qualified consulting firm to provide civil engineering design services for the Fern Drive Bridge Replacement Project. Fern Drive Bridge is located over the San Lorenzo River and is approximately 4.5 miles north of Boulder Creek in Santa Cruz County. The project will consist of completely replacing the existing structure and roadway approaches with a new 2 lane concrete bridge and bridge approaches meeting current design standards. The existing bridge is a three-span, 71- foot-long reinforced concrete deck on steel girder structure. The Fern Drive bridge is being replaced due to substandard load capacity, deck geometry, approach alignment and structural deficiency. The bridge was deemed unstable in April 2025 in the Special Feature Inspection report.
csv_disciplines_requested: Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering
